title: A Terminal for the Static
author: Bram Crane
blurb: Ada Reyes, a terraformer tending a garden meant for people not yet born, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart before Earth's last transmission loop ends.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
